title: Zillow County Home Value Trends Input
description: Choose a ZHVI trend level, housing cut, region filters, as-of date, sort order, and row cap. History mode returns one row per region per month.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: What to return: one trend row per county, per state, per metro, or one history row per region per month. The legacy values keep old saved tasks working and are mapped to the matching trend mode.
enumTitles: County trends — one row per county
State trends — one row per state and DC
Metro trends — one row per metro and US
Monthly history — one row per region per month

homeType.title: Housing cut
homeType.description: Which Zillow Home Value Index series to read. All ten cuts are available at county, state, and metro level.

state.title: State
state.description: Filter counties, metros, or history to one state, or pick a single state in stateTrends. Choose 'all' to include every state. Two-letter codes are accepted by the API.

county.title: County name
county.description: Case-insensitive county-name substring, e.g. 'Gallatin' or 'Los Angeles'. Works in countyTrends and county history. Use regionIds for exact matching.

regionIds.title: Region IDs
regionIds.description: Exact Zillow RegionIDs, e.g. ['3101', '1090']. Works in every mode. When combined with state or county filters, a region must match all of them.

asOfDate.title: As-of date
asOfDate.description: Compute the trend from the latest observation on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Leave empty for the newest published month. Trend modes only.

historyGeography.title: History level
historyGeography.description: Which ZHVI level the monthly history rows come from. Used only in history mode.

startDate.title: History start date
startDate.description: First month to include in history mode (YYYY-MM-DD). Leave empty to start at the oldest published month.

endDate.title: History end date
endDate.description: Last month to include in history mode (YYYY-MM-DD). Leave empty to end at the newest published month.

sortBy.title: Sort by
sortBy.description: Order trend rows and assign ranks across all matching regions before the row cap is applied. Missing metrics sort last without a rank.

maxItems.title: Max rows
maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted records. The default county file has 3,071 rows; history usually needs a date or region filter to stay under the cap.
